definition.rule: envelope sample t used iff EEG t..t+32 all inside [13, 304); EEG outside the span set to NaN before the design matrix, finiteness asserted
definition.train: train people cs role=fit, attended envelope at t in [13, 271]
definition.alpha: same grid logspace(-3, 4, 8); mean per-segment Pearson r over t in [13, 271] on train people cs role=es
definition.refit: fit + es with the selected alpha
definition.margin: r(hat, att) - r(hat, ign) over t in [13, 271]
